svg.title: Two-stage parameter sweep methodology diagram
svg.desc: Stage 1 on the left: coarse then refined E-P grid sweep to find the degraded optimum. Stage 2 on the right: SoC window width series and center series run at the fixed optimum sizing to identify operational levers.
